description: This file declares the ProxyConfigServiceLinux class and its nested classes, which implement system proxy configuration retrieval on Linux systems, including environment variable parsing, gconf/gsettings integration, and notification handling.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceLinux
classes.description: Main class implementing proxy configuration retrieval for Linux, managing a delegate for thread-safe operations.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceLinux::Delegate
classes.description: Handles environment variable and gconf/gsettings interactions, manages notifications, and maintains proxy config state.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceLinux::SettingGetter
classes.description: Abstract interface for fetching proxy settings from system sources, supporting GNOME and KDE.

methods.name: SetupAndFetchInitialConfig
methods.description: Initializes configuration fetching and notification setup.

methods.name: OnCheckProxyConfigSettings
methods.description: Triggers re-fetching of proxy settings based on system changes.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: GetLatestProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent proxy configuration.

methods.name: PostDestroyTask
methods.description: Schedules cleanup of notifications and resources.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Stops notifications and releases resources safely.
